h1: Country Lake View Hotel — a country-style lakeside stay that's still in town
intro: If you want a riverside-resort feel without driving far out of the city · Country Lake View Hotel is a country-style hotel set beside a small lake within central Suphan Buri — easy to reach, near Robinson mall and the hospitals, yet once inside the gates you get green trees, a breeze off the water and a lakeside restaurant with live music · what guests like is the spacious motel-style rooms you can park right outside, clean and roomy, plus an on-site café, with rates from around ฿850/night · it isn't a luxury property, but it offers a more relaxing atmosphere than the usual in-town block hotels.

body.html: Country Lake View Hotel sits at 207 Moo 3, Tha Rahad, Mueang Suphan Buri — in town, but with a lakeside feel · it is within roughly 5 km of Robinson mall, Chao Phraya Yommarat Hospital and Porchai Hospital · open since around 2000, it is an approximately 40-room property laid out motel-style around a small lake and garden · what guests mention most often is getting that trees-and-water atmosphere while still being a short drive from the city centre.

Rooms earn praise for being spacious and clean · they are motel-style rooms where you park right outside your door, which self-drive travellers love · Standard rooms have AC, a TV, a fridge, a large bed, and a table with an armchair · Deluxe rooms are larger at around 40 sq m, with big windows, bathrobes, a hair dryer and a welcome fruit basket · many guests say the rooms feel more generous than the price suggests, suiting couples and small families alike.
"Clean, spacious room, easy to park right at the door, and in the evening you sit at the lakeside restaurant with soft live music — the atmosphere is so good you forget you're still in the city."

The heart of the atmosphere here is the lakeside Lai Nam restaurant, where you dine overlooking the water with live music in the evenings · alongside it is "Tim Kaafae", a loft-barn-style café serving coffee, drinks and homemade bakery · there is also a spa, sauna, massage room and an on-site fitness centre · for a midrange hotel in a small city, having a restaurant, café and relaxation corners all within one compound is an advantage you don't often find.

Worth knowing before you book: the hotel has been open for a good while, so parts of the buildings and furniture look dated — this is not a brand-new property · some reviews note that rooms facing the restaurant or event area can pick up music in the evening, so ask for a room set further back if you want quiet · breakfast is excluded from some rates, so check the conditions when booking · and park-at-your-door spaces have a height limit of about 2.3 m, so taller vehicles use a separate lot.

Country Lake View's location suits people who want to stay in town but with a relaxing feel · it is a short drive to Khum Khun Phaen, Wat Pa Lelai, Banharn–Jaemsai Tower and Chaloem Phatra Rachini Park · out-of-town sights such as Sam Chuk Market and Bueng Chawak need an extra 40 minutes to an hour of driving · if your plan centres on the city and you want somewhere you can sit by the water, this fits nicely.

The honest verdict from real reviews: Country Lake View Hotel is a country-style lakeside hotel that offers more atmosphere than its price — spacious, clean rooms, park-at-your-door parking, a lakeside restaurant and an on-site café · the trade-off is that the property isn't new and some rooms catch evening music · but if you want an in-town Suphan Buri stay that genuinely feels like a break, this is a warm, good-value choice.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Country Lake View Hotel Suphan Buri

faq.q: Where is Country Lake View Hotel · is it in central Suphan Buri?
faq.a: It is at 207 Moo 3, Tha Rahad, Mueang Suphan Buri — in town, but with a lakeside feel · it is about a 10-minute drive from Robinson mall, Khum Khun Phaen and Banharn–Jaemsai Tower · easy to get around the city while still surrounded by trees and water.

faq.q: What are Country Lake View Hotel's starting prices · what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start from around ฿850/night for a Standard room · Deluxe rooms are about ฿1,500–1,800, larger and with breakfast included · there are also pet-friendly rooms and a party/karaoke room · prices vary by season and platform, so compare a few sites before booking.

faq.q: Who is Country Lake View Hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits people who want to stay in Suphan Buri town but with a relaxing waterside feel · spacious rooms, park-at-your-door parking, a lakeside restaurant and an on-site café · good for couples and self-drive families · less suited to those after a brand-new hotel or total quiet in every corner.

faq.q: Does the hotel have a restaurant and parking?
faq.a: Yes — there is a lakeside Lai Nam restaurant with live evening music and the on-site Tim Kaafae café · parking is free and right outside the rooms motel-style, though with a height limit of about 2.3 m — taller vehicles and vans can ask for the separate lot.

faq.q: What can I visit while staying here?
faq.a: It is close to Khum Khun Phaen, Wat Pa Lelai, Banharn–Jaemsai Tower and Robinson mall, all about a 10-minute drive · Sam Chuk 100-Year Market and Bueng Chawak are out of town, needing an extra 45 minutes to an hour of driving.
